bethune1905.line: A photograph taken in Daytona, Florida, in 1905, one year after Mary McLeod Bethune started her school. Bethune stands at the front of a long line of her students. State Archives of Florida. Free to use.

train.line: A wide photograph (a panorama) taken in Key West on January 22, 1912, the day the first train crossed the Florida Keys to reach the island. Taken by Harris Co. Library of Congress. Free to use.
